settings.name: GENERATE_SELF_SIGNED_SSL
settings.description: **Enable Self-signed:** Set to `yes` to enable automatic self-signed certificate generation.

settings.name: SELF_SIGNED_SSL_ALGORITHM
settings.description: **Certificate Algorithm:** Algorithm used for certificate generation: `ec-prime256v1`, `ec-secp384r1`, `rsa-2048`, or `rsa-4096`.

settings.name: SELF_SIGNED_SSL_EXPIRY
settings.description: **Certificate Validity:** Number of days the self-signed certificate should be valid (default: 1 year). Accepts a time suffix (ms, s, m, h, d, w, M, y); a bare number is days.

settings.name: SELF_SIGNED_SSL_SUBJ
settings.description: **Certificate Subject:** Subject field for the certificate that identifies the domain.
